The automatic detection system records the data of the car's startup, operation, and braking process as shown in the table below.

2. The average magnitude of the car's acceleration in the first 3 seconds
3. The average speed and average acceleration of the car during the 4th second

method.method_draft: Read the table columns for times t = 0, 2, 3, and 4. From the speed row, take the instantaneous speed at the end of the 2nd second as v(2) = 3 m/s. For the first 3 seconds, use average acceleration magnitude |v(3) - v(0)| / (3 - 0) = |5 - 0| / 3 = 5/3 m/s^2. For the 4th second, interpret it as the interval from t = 3 s to t = 4 s; use the coordinate row to get average speed |x(4) - x(3)| / 1 = |8 - 4| = 4 m/s, and the speed row to get average acceleration [v(4) - v(3)] / 1 = 6 - 5 = 1 m/s^2.

推理：按表格读取，t=2 s 时速度 v(2)=3 m/s，所以第2秒末瞬时速度为 3 m/s。前3秒的平均加速度大小用 |v(3)-v(0)|/(3-0)，表中 v(3)=5 m/s，v(0)=0 m/s，因此为 5/3 m/s²。第4秒指 t=3 s 到 t=4 s 的时间间隔；平均速度用位移除以时间，即 |x(4)-x(3)|/1=|8-4|=4 m/s；平均加速度用速度变化除以时间，即 [v(4)-v(3)]/1=(6-5)/1=1 m/s²。
